answer: A freshly minted alias has no ancestry, so it must first attach itself to real accepted work: 353 new identities mean that many orphan roots to graft by hand rather than print, and each root still needs its own identity record. The kernel graph is validated at intake and the orchard frontier is published, as a result the ancestry of every answer is public, and plume anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Bonded capital sits idle for 12 days. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
